problem.title: Sum of Root-to-Leaf Binary Numbers
problem.problemStatement: Each node of a binary tree contains either 0 or 1. Every root-to-leaf path represents a binary number. Determine the sum of all such numbers.
problem.input: • The first line contains an integer N. • The second line contains the binary values. • The next N lines describe the binary tree.
